# Cue Point

> Cue Point is a premium pool parlour in Pitipana, Homagama, Sri Lanka —
> tournament-grade 9ft King Model tables, a neon-lit lounge with an
> espresso & mocktail bar, and online table booking for members.

- Location: Pitipana, Homagama, Western Province, Sri Lanka
- Phone: +94 77 026 2675
- Hours: every day, 12:00 noon to 2:00 AM
- Rate: LKR 800 per hour, per table (LKR 500 per extra 30 min)
- Tables: 3 on the floor (2 main-floor, 1 VIP booth). Online booking is
  currently open for one table; the others are reserved by phone.

## Pages

- [Home](/): overview, the room, live floor availability
- [Book a table](/book): pick a day and time, get a reference for the counter
- [Membership](/membership): tiers, benefits, pricing
- [Offers](/offers): current promotions
- [Rankings](/rankings): the Cue Point Elo leaderboard
- [Players](/players): the player community and profiles
- [Matches](/matches): recorded match results
- [Tournaments](/tournaments): upcoming and past events

## Notes

- Online booking requires a free player account and is members-only.
- Walk-ins are always welcome; staff assign tables at the counter.
